name: Morada Nomade Content Wall
author: Morada Nomade

sections.description:
Morada Nomade Content Wall lets you present content in Walls: organized,
highly configurable content areas that you publish anywhere on your website.

The Free plugin includes:

  • WordPress Posts — display the posts of your own site in a Wall,
    synchronized automatically.
  • Menu Cards — create menus of cards (products, services, dishes,
    announcements) and present them in the same Wall experience.
  • Wall Groups, Walls and Queries — organize content in Wall Groups
    composed of Walls, each fed by its own content Queries.
  • Content Experiences — present each Wall as a Feed or a Media
    Carousel, with configurable Themes, appearance and interactions.
  • Snapshots and Cache — content is materialized and served from
    snapshots, keeping the public rendering fast and stable.
  • Internationalization — the interface ships in English with complete
    catalogs for pt_BR, pt_PT, es_ES, fr_FR, de_DE and it_IT.

Morada Nomade Content Wall is fully functional on its own. It does not
require a license, an account or any external service.

Morada Nomade Content Wall Pro, distributed separately, extends the same
Walls with commercial integrations: external WordPress sites, Facebook,
Instagram, YouTube, Google Drive and Google Photos.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the
    /wp-content/plugins/morada-nomade-content-wall directory, or install the
    plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the MN Content Wall menu to create your first Wall Group and its Walls.
sections.faq:
Does the Free plugin require a license?

No. Morada Nomade Content Wall is free, permanent and fully functional on
its own.

What does the Pro plugin add?

Morada Nomade Content Wall Pro is a separate add-on that extends the same
Walls with commercial content integrations (external WordPress sites,
Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google Drive, Google Photos) and the
corresponding administration and licensing.
sections.changelog:
2.2.4

  • Content availability verification also applies to content that a Wall’s
    component reads from other Walls, using each Wall’s own verification
    settings. Feed and Media Carousel behave as before.
  • The Plugins screen shows a link to MN Content Wall Pro among the plugin’s
    actions, following the same rules as the other Pro announcements.

2.2.3

  • Plugin name changed to Morada Nomade Content Wall in the plugin header and
    readme, as requested by the WordPress.org review. No functional changes.

2.2.2

  • Text domain and translation catalogs renamed to
    morada-nomade-content-wall, the plugin slug on WordPress.org.
  • Administration pages and Wall output are escaped at the point of output;
    admin pages are rendered directly by their templates.
  • wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php is loaded only where dbDelta() is called.
  • Plugin URI now points to the product page.
  • The optional “Powered by” / “Made with” credit and the links that present
    MN Content Wall Pro point to the product page.

2.2.1

  • The Free plugin no longer limits the number of posts per Query or the
    number of Queries per Wall.
  • Licensing, license notifications and the code that serves only
    MN Content Wall Pro integrations now belong exclusively to the Pro plugin.
  • Administration scripts and styles are loaded through the WordPress
    enqueue API, and JSON output uses wp_json_encode().
  • Translation catalogs regenerated.
  • Readme updated with the current terminology and the Pro integrations.

2.2.0

  • First release prepared for WordPress.org distribution.
